cycles.intent: Canonical green-dominant elongated oval hull,gold side fields and crown,slate gondolas and darker ventral casings. Derive colours/PBR from current canonical GLBs;preserve precision horns and articulated repair chains,and add separately closing jaws.
cycles.comparison_conditions: Actual canonical and engineering GLB imports rendered by the same studio function;independent framing for style review,not game scale.
observations: Reviewed actual engineering and canonical GLB imports in the same studio. Green-dominant elongated oval hull,gold fields/crown,slate gondolas and bronze/ventral casings share the Delphini Assault/Lazzaro family.
The rounded hull form is culturally supported by both canonical references;defined metal tool links remain separate from the curved body. No dense decorative panel grid.

Actual native/imported front,rear and top views plus 0/1/2/3-second working poses inspected. Precision horns retain rooted motion;repair shoulder/elbow positioning precedes independent jaw closure while the welding arm remains articulated.

Palette and effective PBR values are measured from current canonical GLB textures/factors. Untextured titanium/graphite factors are converted from linear RGB to sRGB map values. Graphite metalness/roughness are approximate within the shared material helper bounds;source hue is retained.

Function-specific tools and carrier proportions remain distinct from combat/research ships. Display is independently fitted;game scale and continuous swept clearance remain provisional. User artistic acceptance remains pending.
remaining: Graphite PBR approximation and deliberately different utility tooling.
Game scale,platform profiling and continuous swept clearance remain outside asset-proposal verification.
